name: theplayer
description: Modular MoQ player with an original HLS engine

scripts.format: prettier --write src demo scripts tests server.mjs package.json README.md docs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src demo scripts tests server.mjs package.json README.md docs
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
